title: Buy the best seed you can

unit.title: Buy the best seed you can
unit.needIt: Seed is the cheapest thing in a garden and the one thing work cannot fix. A few cents more decides the whole season.
unit.why: An amateur gardener thought that only hard work mattered for a good crop. He believed any seed would work if you just took good care of the plant. However, he did not realize that some seeds are born with better traits that no amount of care can fix.
unit.outcome: Select high-quality seeds from reputable firms to ensure a successful garden.
unit.reachesYou: You see this when you shop for groceries and notice some brands are more reliable than others. You also see it when you choose a brand of tool that is known to last a long time.
unit.do: Research one well-known seed company that has a long history of selling high-quality garden seeds.

quiz.q: What is the most important factor for growing superior quality vegetables?
quiz.why: The text states that using only the best kind of seed is very important for quality.
quiz.quote: T is very important that seed of only the best kind should be used, if we would grow vegetables of superior quality.

quiz.q: What did the amateur gardener believe about seeds?
choices: Any seed works if you care for it
quiz.why: The amateur gardener argued that the culture you give the plant is what counts.
quiz.quote: Plant any kind of seed that happens to be handiest and take good care of the plants that grow from it and you'll have good vegetables.

quiz.q: Can good care make a bad seed produce a superior vegetable?
quiz.why: The text says no amount of culture can make a superior vegetable from inferior seed.
quiz.quote: No amount of culture can make a superior vegetable from plants grown from inferior seed.

quiz.q: How does the size of your garden affect seed choice?
quiz.why: The text explains that the smaller the garden is, the more important it is to use the best seed.
quiz.quote: The smaller it is, the greater the importance of using only the best.

quiz.q: How can you identify a reliable seed firm?
choices: By their long history and reputation
By the color of the bag
By the size of the office
quiz.why: Reliable firms have been in existence for years and have built a reputation for quality.
quiz.quote: We have in this country many seed firms that have been in existence for years, some of them over half a century, and these have built up for themselves a reputation for handling only seed of the very best.

quiz.q: What is the risk of buying 'cheap' seed advertised as 'just as good'?
choices: It will not grow at all
It will be poor in quality
quiz.why: The text warns that cheap seed is likely to be cheap in quality as well as price.
quiz.quote: Cheap seed, that which is advertised as being ''just as good as higher-priced seed for a much smaller amount of money'', is likely to prove as cheap in quality as in price.

partials: Only the best kind of seed gives superior quality.
No amount of care fixes inferior seed.
Small gardens need the best seeds even more.
Old firms have reputations for high quality.
Cheap seed is often poor in quality.
crystal.key: Quality seeds are the foundation of a successful garden.

decoys.text: Good care can make any seed grow well.
decoys.why: The text says no amount of culture can make a superior vegetable from inferior seed.

decoys.text: Cheap seeds are a good way to save money.
decoys.why: The text says cheap seed is likely to be cheap in quality as well as price.

crystal.aha: The quality of the starting seed determines the final result more than the care provided later.
